title: BMW Induction Service Adapter
lead: A new induction service adapter for BMW vehicles.
body: It connects through the 73446 adapter for a 90-degree connection, or the 73447 adapter for a straight connection. The MAP sensor cup on the adapter lets the MAP sensor stay connected during the service, which helps prevent setting a code. The result is a quicker, more reliable induction cleaning service.
source: TSB Vol. 25 No 01 - BMW Induction Service Adapter.pdf
